0|db670dac49b5423b39b5e523d28fe32045d71b10|torvalds~linux|/home/usuario01/Titan-Files-Research/src/_00/output/C/torvalds~linux|False|"sched: Fix and optimise calculation of the weight-inverse
If the inverse loadweight should be zero
calculates the inverse of ""lw->weight"" (in 32bit integer ops).
This calculation is actually a little bit impure (because it is
inverting something around ""lw-weight""+1)
lw->weight"" becomes smaller.
The correct inverse would be 1/lw->weight multiplied by
WMULT_CONST"" for fixcomma-scaling it into integers.
(So WMULT_CONST/lw->weight ...)
The old
column2: impure algorithm took two divisions for inverting lw->weight

column1: the new
column2: more exact one only takes one and an additional unlikely-if.
